text:
Eli: heads up, spotted another onboarding trap. python quickstart shows `REDWOOD_TOKEN` env var and an `Authorization: Token` header. new devs copy-pasting get 401s. snippet:
```py
# quickstart
import os, requests
resp = requests.post(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',
  headers={'Authorization': 'Token ' + os.getenv('REDWOOD_TOKEN')},
  json={'prompt': 'hi'}
)
```

Rosa: agreed — our canonical is `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. looks like a copy from an ancient internal doc. also some samples use `requests` while others show `httpx` with async; inconsistent patterns confuse users.

Eli: i'm going to standardize to synchronous `requests` example with `Authorization: Bearer` for the quickstart and add an async `httpx` variant in an "advanced" section. will also replace env var everywhere.

Docs Bot: grep results: found `REDWOOD_TOKEN` in docs/quickstart/python/README.md and docs/samples/tts/python-sample.md. found `Authorization: Token` in docs/snippets/legacy-auth.md.

Rosa: tiny ask: include a one-liner 'Where to find your API key' pointing to Console -> Settings -> API Keys. saves folks from asking support.

Eli: will add that. also adding a docs-lint rule `scripts/lint-auth.sh` that fails on `REDWOOD_TOKEN` or `Authorization:\s*Token`. will wire into docs CI.

QA Bot: recommend adding a smoke test in `tests/docs_examples` that runs the python snippet against a local mock and asserts the `Authorization` header equals `Bearer test-key`. can reuse existing mock server.

Eli: good call. PR #537 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/537 — replaces env var, updates examples, adds lint and smoke test.

Docs Bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/537 — examples page updated. lint run: scripts/lint-auth.sh exit=0.

Rosa: filed DOCS-82 to track multi-language example parity (python/js/ruby) so we keep auth + env var consistent across quickstarts.

Eli: updated sample-app README, added CHANGELOG note, and pinged @onboarding to update KB links. closing after merge. :white_check_mark:
